description.en: The key of the application that is used to make an API call.

description.zh: APP名称。支持汉字、英文字母、数字、英文格式的下划线，且必须以字母或汉字开始，长度限制为4~26个字符
description.en: The name of the application. The name must be 4 to 26 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_), and must start with a letter.

description.zh: APP描述信息，长度不超过180个字符
description.en: The description of the application. The description can be up to 180 characters in length.

description.zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个。
description.en: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

description.zh:
标签键。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
description.en:
The key of the tag.

Valid values of n: `[1, 20]`.

description.zh:
标签值。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`。当参数有值，要求对应当tag.N.Key在相同的N的标签键也传入值，否则会报错。
description.en:
The value of the tag.

Valid values of n: `[1, 20]`. If the parameter has a value, you must specify a value for the tag key with the same N as tag.N.Key. Otherwise, an error is reported.

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向调用API的用户
- 每个APP有一对Key和Value密钥对，该密钥在调用API时用于身份验证
- APP调用API需要建立授权关系，即授予APP调用某API的权限
- 一个APP下只能有一对密钥，若密钥泄露可以重置
- 每个阿里云账号创建APP的个数上限是1000个
- 该接口调用的QPS限制为：单用户QPS不超过50
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API callers.

- Each application has a key-value pair which is used for identity verification when you call an API.

- An application must be authorized to call an API.

- Each application has only one key-value pair, which can be reset if the pair is leaked.

- A maximum of 1,000 applications can be created for each Alibaba Cloud account.

- Allows up to 50 calls per second per account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi create-app --app-name CreateAppTest --description test --tag Value=example-string Key=env --app-key 60030986 --app-secret nzyNqFkRWB2uLw86 --app-code 3aaf905a0a1f4f0eabc6d891dfa08afc --extend 110210264071 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi CreateApp --region cn-hangzhou --AppCode 3aaf905a0a1f4f0eabc6d891dfa08afc --Tag.1.Key env --Description test --Extend 110210264071 --AppKey 60030986 --Tag.1.Value 'example-string' --AppSecret nzyNqFkRWB2uLw86 --AppName CreateAppTest
